description: Upload durable files directly to an agent and search or automatically recall their extracted contents.
skill_summary: How to search and read files uploaded into the agent's own managed knowledge directory, preserve file citations, and distinguish these durable files from chat attachments.
note: Files are agent-owned and stored under the agent data directory, separate from user chat attachments.

settings.label: Automatic File Recall
settings.hint: Search files marked for recall before substantive turns and inject a few cited excerpts.

settings.label: Maximum Search Results
settings.hint: Hard cap for managed-file search results returned to the agent.

settings.label: Recall Excerpt Characters
settings.hint: Maximum characters injected from each automatically recalled file.
